title: QA Engineer
description:
### **Description**

As a Automation Engineer, you will be involved throughout the development lifecycle of Infor Birst development team with responsibility in the quality assurance of software development and deployment with emphasis on development and implementation of test automation. You'll be involved in the creation of business requirements inputting the test scripts and test scenarios to ensure developers understand the business requirements so that they can be effectively tested.  
  
You will be working closely with developers as they develop code to ensure requirements are being met and to the correct quality, and you will conduct automated (and manual tests where necessary) to ensure the software created is fit for purpose. During testing you will be thinking "outside of the box" to understand the various scenarios and configurations that customers use to ensure customer quality is maintained and through doing so drive regression testing across the products. You will be responsible for defining and driving innovative automated testing strategies and toolsets into our overall development processes that support and enhance the current Quality Assurance processes within Birst.  
  
We are seeking exceptional QA automation engineers to join our team in Ahmedabad, India to design and execute test suites for our Business Intelligence and Analytics products. In addition to regular quality assurance activities, automating tests using common automation frameworks such as TestNG and Selenium, is a requirement. So, if the thought of automation is exciting and if you can do most of the following then you’re going to fit right in with our exciting team here.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Work as part of cross functional, passionate agile development teams to ensure quality is driven into the heart of the development process from requirements definition through to delivery of highly concurrent system
* Evangelize new testing methodologies, best practices, and tools with goals to continuously improve test coverage through automation
* Proactively bringing issues and problems to the attention of the team, generating, proposing, and implementing innovative solutions to solve them
* Be meticulous about documentation and maintaining test cases and test results.
* Designing, developing, and supporting frameworks for test infrastructure and providing automation expertise
* Research, recommend and implement tools as needed with the goal of increasing automation
* Ensure that all tests are executed and give regular feedback to the team lead on the status of quality
* Work closely with the Product Management and Development Teams
* Be a creative thinker who can quickly identify and test for functional ‘edge cases’ outside of expected functionality workflow
* Test backend API's (REST and SOAP) and front-end UI applications
* Mentor team members on automation
* Willingness to work across time zones to interact with different stakeholders located across US west coast, Europe, and India

  

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of experience as hands on Software QA/automation Engineer
* Strong programming/scripting ability in any language, preferably Java
* Thorough understanding of SDLC, specifically automated QA processes in agile development environments
* Experience in writing, executing, and monitoring automated test suites using a variety of technologies including, but not limited to, Selenium, Groovy, Junit, TestNG, SoapUI, RESTful Client
* Proficient with bug tracking and test management toolsets to support development processes
* Strong working knowledge of testing fundamentals such as TDD & BDD
* Expertise testing RESTful, SOAP web services in SOA system
* Working knowledge of Database concepts
* + Demonstrated knowledge of CI/CD tools to integrate the Automation scripts
* + Strong experience in testing ETL, BI and SaaS solutions
* + A high degree of self-motivation and flexibility with the ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks
* + The ability to interact creatively and achieve results in a fast-moving, dynamic small company environment
* + Excellent communication and teamwork skills

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Domain knowledge in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics
* Prior experience working with systems such as ActiveMQ, MongoDB, Elastic-Search and nginx
* Prior experience with security protocols such as OAuth and SAML and related frameworks
* Working knowledge of virtualization and Infrastructure as Service solutions such as Amazon Web Services
* Building test infrastructures using containerization technologies such as Docker and working within continuous delivery / continuous release pipeline processes
* ISTQB, CSQA or CSTE certified

title: Software QA Engineer
description:
**Manual QA Tester**

**Location:** South Bopal, Ahmedabad  
**Salary:** ₹12,000 – ₹20,000 per month  
**Experience:** Fresher to 1 year

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and motivated **Manual QA Tester** to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of software testing, a willingness to learn, and the ability to identify and report bugs.

Responsibilities

* Understand project requirements and prepare test cases.
* Perform manual testing of web and mobile applications.
* Identify, document, and report bugs clearly.
* Perform functional, regression, and UI testing.
* Verify bug fixes and retest applications.
* Collaborate with developers and team members to ensure product quality.

Requirements

* 0–1 year of experience in software testing.
* Freshers with basic knowledge of manual testing are welcome.
* Understanding of SDLC and STLC.
* Basic knowledge of test cases, test scenarios, and bug reporting.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
* Basic knowledge of Jira or other bug-tracking tools is a plus.

What We Offer

* Salary of ₹12,000 – ₹20,000 per month, based on skills and experience.
* Opportunity to learn and grow in software testing.
* Supportive team environment.
* Hands-on experience with real-world projects.

**Interested candidates can share their resume to apply.**

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ahmedabad, Gujarat

title: QA Engineer / Software Testing Intern
description:
**Company:** Savannah Labs  
**Position:** QA Intern / Software Testing Intern  
**Internship Duration:** 6 Months (Full-Time)  
**Experience:** Fresher / Internship  
**Location:** Ellisbridge, Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full-Time Internship  
**Work Location:** In Person (On-site)

**Job Description:**

We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented **QA Engineer / Software Testing Intern (Manual & Automation)** to join our team.

The ideal candidate should have basic knowledge of software testing concepts and a willingness to learn manual and automation testing for web applications.

During this 6-month internship, the candidate will gain hands-on experience in testing web applications, identifying bugs, executing test cases, and collaborating with developers to ensure software quality and functionality.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand project requirements, user stories, and application functionalities.
* Assist in performing **manual and basic automation testing** on web applications.
* Test **frontend (React)** applications and **backend APIs (Node.js)** under guidance.
* Learn to write, execute, and maintain test cases and test scenarios.
* Identify, document, report, and track software bugs.
* Assist in performing **functional, regression, smoke, and UI testing**.
* Perform basic API testing using **Postman**.
* Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and project managers to understand and resolve issues.
* Support the QA team in ensuring application quality and timely delivery.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of **Software Testing concepts (SDLC/STLC)**.
* Fundamental knowledge of **Manual Testing** and testing methodologies.
* Basic understanding of **web applications and MERN Stack technologies**.
* Familiarity with **API testing using Postman**.
* Understanding of **Bug Life Cycle** and defect reporting.
* Basic knowledge of **SQL / MongoDB** (preferred).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and attention to detail.
* Willingness to learn new testing tools and technologies.

Good to Have

* Basic knowledge of **Automation Testing tools (Selenium / Cypress / Playwright)**.
* Understanding of **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Familiarity with bug-tracking tools such as Jira.
* Basic knowledge of JavaScript.
* Academic projects or training related to software testing.
* Understanding of SaaS or web-based applications.

Eligibility Criteria

* Freshers or candidates looking to start their careers in Software Testing / Quality Assurance.
* Students or recent graduates in **B.Tech, B.E., BCA, MCA, B.Sc. IT, M.Sc. IT**, or related fields.
* Basic knowledge of manual testing and software development concepts.
* Willingness to commit to a **6-month full-time internship**.
* Candidates should be comfortable working from our Ahmedabad office.

What We Offer

* **6 months of practical, hands-on internship experience**.
* Opportunity to work on live web applications and real-world projects.
* Exposure to Manual Testing, API Testing, and Automation Testing.
* Guidance and mentorship from experienced developers and QA professionals.
* Collaborative and learning-focused work environment.
* Opportunity to enhance technical and professional skills.

About Savannah Labs

At Savannah Labs, we’re not just another software company we build cutting-edge AI-powered products and solutions that transform businesses globally. Our highly skilled and experienced development team has worked with top companies across industries.

We offer a collaborative, growth-driven work culture, where you'll get the chance to work with the latest technologies and learn continuously from industry veterans.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:

**Email:** hr@savannah-labs.com

Job Type: Full-time

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable attending the final interview round on-site at our Panchvati office?
* What is your earliest available joining date?
* Are you a fresher or do you have any prior internship experience in Software Testing?
* Do you have basic knowledge of Manual Testing and Software Testing concepts?
* Are you familiar with API testing tools such as Postman?
* Are you comfortable committing to a 6-month full-time internship?
* Are you comfortable working on-site at our Ellisbridge, Ahmedabad office?

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. QA Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Exp: \-4 TO 5 Years**

Manual Testing: Functional Testing, Regression Testing, Smoke/Sanity Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing, Exploratory Testing.  
Test Documentation: Test Scenario, Test Case, Test Data, RTM, Test Summary Report, Defect Reports.  
Defect Management: Defect identification, logging, severity/priority classification, defect lifecycle, retesting \& closure.  
Automation Testing: Selenium / Playwright / Cypress; automation framework development and maintenance.  
Frameworks: Page Object Model (POM).  
API Testing: Postman, REST API testing.  
Database Testing: SQL queries, CRUD operations.  
Performance Testing Basic/Intermediate knowledge of JMeter, load testing, stress testing, response\-time analysis.  
Version Control: Git, GitLab/GitHub, branching, merge, commit, pull/merge requests.  
Bug Tracking: Jira or similar tools.  
Agile/Scrum : Sprint planning, daily stand\-up, backlog, refinement, review, retrospective.  
Requirement Analysis: Understanding BRD/FRD/URS, identifying testable requirements, clarification of gaps.  
Test Strategy: Test planning, estimation, test approach, risk\-based testing.

Release Testing: Build verification, release validation, regression testing, production verification.  
Mobile Testing: Basic Android/iOS testing and responsive testing.  
Communication: Client communication, requirement clarification, defect discussion and status reporting.  
Provide regular status updates to stakeholders.  
Take ownership of QA deliverables, timelines, and project quality without continuous supervision.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Exp. CTC

Experience:

* Software testing: 2 years (Preferred)

Location:

* Bodakdev, Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Preferred)
